specification.source_spec_relationship: Uses the same six experimentally mapped contacts. This is a separate two-target explanatory association family, not a replacement for the two R12 cross-layer primary tests or an independent replication of prior cell-line analyses.
specification.cohort: Cell lines with complete protein, RNA and CNV for ARID1A and all six contacts, known lineage, and both prespecified target dependency scores. Both targets use exactly the same complete-case rows.
specification.patient_selection: Reuse R12 patient selection: after assay-index and valid-lineage matching, keep the lexicographically smallest ModelID per known patient, before shared complete-case filtering. Unknown patient identifiers are cell-specific. Do not substitute a different same-patient line when the selected line has missing bridge measurements.
specification.module_model: For each of the six fixed contact genes, OLS protein ~ own RNA + own CNV + lineage. Globally center and scale each residual vector to sample SD 1 (ddof=1), then take their equally weighted mean. Neither target dependency is used to select genes, signs, weights, covariates or transformations. ARID1A and ARID1B are never module members.
specification.conditional_association_model: For each target, regress the target dependency and the protein module separately on the identical covariates ARID1A protein + ARID1A RNA + ARID1A CNV + lineage. Compute Spearman correlation of the two residual vectors. This is residual Spearman coupling after linear adjustment, not a rank-transformed partial-Spearman regression.
specification.descriptive_incremental_r_squared: In the same rows, compare OLS dependency ~ ARID1A protein + ARID1A RNA + ARID1A CNV + lineage with the model additionally containing the fixed protein module. Report in-sample ordinary R-squared and its increment without a separate P value or any claim of generalizable prediction. The full model must separately meet the minimum residual-df rule.
specification.resampling: Stratified nonparametric cell-row bootstrap within lineage with shared indices for both dependency targets and every assay. Preserve repeated draws. Refit all six RNA/CNV/lineage models, recalculate residual standardization and module means, and refit both common-covariate regressions in every replicate. No resampling or reselection of genes.
specification.uncertainty: Percentile 95% CI for residual rho plus two-sided centered approximate bootstrap P=(1+count(abs(rho_boot-rho_obs)>=abs(rho_obs)))/(1+B_valid). This is not an exact null test; percentile CI and centered P are not strictly dual. A primary result requires at least 95% valid replicates.
specification.multiplicity: BH over exactly the ARID1A and ARID1B residual-correlation tests. Retain family size two even if one is non-evaluable. This family is reported distinctly from the original R12 cross-layer and external-replication families; do not claim study-wide FDR control.
specification.non_evaluable_policy: Do not omit, replace, reweight or impute a missing or zero-residual-variance module member. Insufficient shared n, insufficient module/conditional-model df, or a degenerate fixed module makes the relevant association non-evaluable. A constant target invalidates only that target, not the other target. Retain corrected-null estimates.
specification.interpretation: Negative rho means a higher adjusted protein-module score accompanies stronger (more negative) dependency; positive rho means weaker dependency. Conditioning on measured ARID1A protein asks about coupling beyond the measured anchor and may remove a biologically mediated component or introduce conditioning bias. Association does not establish protein degradation, complex stability, causal dependency, cBAF-specific synthetic lethality, treatment benefit or generalizable prediction. No new deep-learning or supervised feature-selection model is introduced.

source_specification.patient_selection: Among matched cell lines, retain lexicographically smallest ModelID per known patient in primary analysis. Missing/Unknown/NA patient IDs receive unique cell-specific identifiers, never one shared missing-patient cluster.
source_specification.coverage_design_note: Sanger protein header audit finds no ACTB or BICRA. Primary background is the six prespecified broad-BAF background genes with exact symbol measurements; it is not a geometry-controlled within-cBAF noncontact panel. The ACTB+ACTL6A physical contrast must be reported non-evaluable if ACTB is absent; ACTL6A-only is descriptive sensitivity. No association results were used to make this feasibility decision.
source_specification.primary_adjustment: Each protein is regressed on its own RNA, own gene-level CNV, and available predeclared sample covariates. Spearman correlation of residuals. Cell-line covariate is lineage; CPTAC covariates are documented purity/batch when available, with a base RNA/CNV-only analysis reported separately.
source_specification.sensitivity_adjustment: Both proteins are regressed on the common set of the anchor and partner RNA/CNV and the same sample covariates.
source_specification.resampling: Shared lineage-stratified cell-line row indices for all genes and modalities, retaining repeated draws, refitting both regressions per pair per draw. One cell line per source patient in the inferential primary cell-line panel; retain additional same-patient lines only for descriptive sensitivity. CPTAC one tumor per patient per cohort; same cohort row draws shared across all genes.
source_specification.p_value: Two-sided centered bootstrap approximation: (1+count(abs(T_boot-T_obs)>=abs(T_obs)))/(1+B_valid). Report percentile confidence intervals separately; not an exact test.
source_specification.multiplicity: BH across the two primary tests within discovery. External replication: BH across two tests times available predeclared cancer cohorts, not selecting the more favorable cohort/model. Sensitivity analyses report estimates and intervals without creating alternative primary positives.
source_specification.epigenomic_primary: GSE101966 interaction (ARID1A_KO+ARID1B_KD minus ARID1A_KO) minus (ARID1B_KD minus WT). Genome-wide BH. Public FPKM-only limma is explicitly exploratory. Two independent infections per group, not two independent ARID1A-KO clones. Module expression does not imply module dependency.
source_specification.interpretation: Fixed-panel conditional association and cross-cohort replication, not proof of protein degradation, complex assembly, cBAF-specific synthetic lethality, or patient treatment benefit. Retain corrected-null findings. No new deep-learning model unless prespecified molecular analyses establish a data-supported need.

inference: Two-target fixed-module conditional association family; in-sample R-squared is descriptive only
